en: A black-and-white postcard image of a riverside cityscape. In the foreground, there is a river with a wooden dock and a small rowboat. Across the river, there are several large buildings, including a significant church with a tall spire. Trees line the riverside. The sky is clear with a few clouds. The text at the bottom left reads 'Umeå. Älvparti.' and at the bottom right credits the photo to 'A/B Almquist & Cöster, Hälsingborg.'
